spans.s:
पथ् पथ् (connected with rt. पन्थ्,
q. v.), cl. 1. P. पथति, पपाथ, अप-
थीत्, पथितुम्, to go, move; cl. 10. P. पाथयति,
&c., to throw, cast, send.

पथ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पत्; generally
only at the end of a comp.), a path, way, road,
course, reach; [cf. अ-पथ, अज-प्˚, अदर्शन-प्˚,
&c.; cf. also Zend पथन्, ‘way;’ Gr. πάτο-ς,
πατέ-ω, πόντο-ς; Lat. pon(t)-s, ponti-fex; Slav.
patĭ, ‘way;’ Old Germ. pad, fad, phat; Angl.
Sax. padh, päd; Hib. fath, ‘a district, field.’]
—पथ-कल्पना, f. juggling tricks, conjuring.
—पथ-दर्शक, अस्, m. ‘way-shower,’ a guide,
conductor.
—पथातिथि (˚थ-अत्˚), इस्, m. a traveller,
wayfarer.
—पथे-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing
in the way or on the road.

पाथ पाथ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा),
fire; the sun; (अम्), n. water [cf. पीथ]; N. of a
Sāman; = पथ.
पथक, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the way, a guide.

पथत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, travelling; (अन्), m.
a road.

पथिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, knowing the way,
going on a road; (अस्), m. a traveller, wayfarer; a
guide, one who knows the way.
—पथिक-सन्तति
or पथिक-संहति, इस्, f. or पथिक-सार्थ, अस्,
m. a collection or company of travellers, a caravan.
—पथिकाश्रय (˚क-आश्˚), अस्, m. an asylum for
travellers, an inn.
पथिका, f. a kind of vine with red grapes.

पथिन्, पन्थास्, m. (nom. voc. sing. पन्थास् fr.
a base पन्थस्, the other strong cases fr. पन्थन्,
acc. pl. and other weak cases fr. पथ्, middle cases
fr. पथिन्, see
Gram. 162

; Ved. acc. sing. is पन्-
थाम् for पन्थानम्, nom. pl. पन्थास् or पन्-
थासस् or पथयस् for पन्थानस्), a path, way,
road, course; a path in morals or religion, sect, doc-
trine; a division of hell (Manu
IV. 90

); पन्था-
नः सन्तु ते शिवाः, may thy ways be happy! a
happy journey to thee! पथि न्य्-अस्, see under
न्य्-अस्).
—पथन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing
the word पथिन्.
—पथि-कार, अस्, m. ‘road-
maker,’ N. of a man (?).
—पथि-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
making a road, constructing a path, preparing a way
or ways; guiding, a guide; (त्), m. an epithet of
Agni.
—पथि-देय, अम्, n. a toll levied on public
roads.
—पथि-द्रुम, अस्, m. the tree Acacia
Catechu.
—पथि-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted
with roads.
—पथि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the
word पथिन्.
—पथि-मध्ये, ind. in the middle
of the road.
—पथि-रक्षि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. or पथि-
रक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. protecting ways or roads.
—पथि-वाहक, अस्, m. a fowler, bird-catcher; a
porter, burden-bearer; (अस्, आ, अम्), cruel, hard.
—पथि-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting in the way; an
epithet of Rudra; of the dogs of Yama.
—पथि-
ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing in the way or on
the road.
—पथि-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being on the
way, going.
पथिल, अस्, m. a traveller, wayfarer.

पथ्य, अस्, आ, अम् (lit. belonging to a road,
suitable for the way or course of anything), proper,
fit, suitable, salutary, wholesome, agreeing with,
(often said in a medical sense of diet, regimen, &c.);
according to rule, containing elements or leading
forms; (अस्), m. Terminalia Chebula or Citrina;
N. of a teacher of the Atharva-veda; (आ), f. a path,
way, road, (पथ्या रेवती, f., Ved. ‘the rich path,’
personified as a deity of happiness and welfare); the
tree Terminalia Chebula or Citrina; other plants
(= मृगेर्वारु, चिर्भिटा, बन्ध्या, कर्कोटकी);
N. of several metres, a sort of Bṛhatī; a kind of
Paṅkti; a kind of Āryā; a kind of Vaktra; (अम्),
n. a species of salt; [cf. अ-पथ्य.]
—पथ्य-शाक,
अस्, m. a species of vegetable.
—पथ्यापथ्य
(˚य-अप्˚), अम्, n. ‘wholesome and unwholesome,’
the class of things that are considered beneficial or
hurtful in disease.
—पथ्याशिन् (˚य-आश्˚), ई, इनी, इ,
eating or an eater of wholesome diet.

पाथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a spot or place;
(Sāy.) N. of a Ṛṣi.

पाथस्, अस्, n., Ved. a spot, place; food; air;
water.
—पाथो-ज, अम्, n. ‘water-born,’ a lotus.
—पाथो-द, अस्, m. ‘water-giver,’ a cloud.
—पा-
थो-धर, अस्, m. ‘water-bearer,’ a cloud.
—पा-
थो-धि, इस्, m. ‘receptacle of waters,’ the ocean.
—पाथो-निधि, इस्, m. ‘treasure-house of waters,’
the ocean.
—पाथो-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. possessing
room or space.

पाथिस्, इस्, m. the sea; the eye; (इस्), n. a blotch,
scab; water (?).

पाथेय पाथेय, अम्, n. (fr. पथिन्), pro-
vender or provisions &c. for a journey, viaticum; the
sign of the zodiac Virgo (= पाथोन).
—पाथेय-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with provisions for a
journey, provisioned.

पाथोन पाथोन (corrupted fr. the Gr.
παρθένος), Ved. the sign of the zodiac Virgo.

पाथ्न्य पाथ्न्य, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic
of Dadhīca.
